\begin{example} \end{example}[Explicit Hopf--Lax solution: $H(p) = \frac{1}{2}|p|^2$, $g = -|x|$] ↗ thm:hopf-lax-formula-weak-solution 1. ch3:3.3.3-ex-3\group Hamilton-Jacobi Equations

For $g(x)=-|x|$, the same Hamiltonian gives \[ u(x,t)=\min _y\left\{ \frac{|x-y|^2}{2t}-|y|\right\} =-|x|-\frac t2. \] \end{example}
